messages:
maya: CI is red on main after the libx change — lots of flakes, but the failing job shows an auth error on the secrets step. cc @sam @owen

sam: saw that. failing log has: `Error: KMS DecryptAccessDenied` when pulling VAULT_ROOT_TOKEN from secret-manager. looks like the runner role lost kms:Decrypt perms.

own: I just checked the runner instance role binding — no changes in IaC for a few days. could be a token rotation on the KMS side or GH App token expiry.

maya: requeue? can someone trigger a manual rerun after we investigate? not sure if rerun will help if perms are actually broken.

ci-bot: workflow run #3421 for repo/redwood/inference failed — job: integration/e2e-android — step: fetch-secrets -> exit code 1. https://github.com/redwood/inference/actions/runs/3421

jen: pinging infra rotation logs now. @sam do you have permission to check KMS audit logs? I can jump in after a call.

sam: checking CloudKMS audit events: returned a `PermissionDenied` for `projects/…/locations/global/keyRings/default/cryptoKeys/root-token` at 2026-03-17T09:02:14Z. Caller = github-runner-prod.

maya: that matches the failing job time. any recent deploys touching iam-bindings?

own: not from me. last change was two days ago to the autoscaler.

sam: quick test: from a runner pod I tried `gcloud kms decrypt --key=projects/.../cryptoKeys/root-token --ciphertext-file=ct.bin` and got `PERMISSION_DENIED: Resource not accessible by service account`.

maya: OK sounds like the runner SA lost the KMS IAM role. two paths: (1) restore kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter role to runner SA from infra vault role, (2) if this was caused by GH App token rotation failing, add a short-lived workaround secret to avoid blocking. prefer restoring IAM.

jen: I just saw an admin policy change PR merged yesterday titled "lockdown-broker-roles" — @owen can you check if that removed the binding?

own: ugh yeah that PR tightened several bindings. I grepped it — it removed `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the runner-SA for one keyring (we scoped it to platform-only). looks like that was overzealous.

maya: ok please re-add the binding scoped to the specific key used by CI (not all keys). can you open a revert or a targeted fix?

own: opening PR now: revert part of lockdown-broker-roles for the runner SA on the CI key. PR: https://git.company/internal/infra/changes/582 — includes iam grant back.

sam: once PR merges, we'll need a k8s pod restart for active runners or just wait for new runners to pick up the role. recommend manual rerun after merge.

maya: can someone kick a rerun of the failing workflow after merge? I'll hold off merging any other changes.

jen: merging the fix to restore kms decrypt on the runner-SA. will also add an audit note. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: PR #582 merged by jen at 2026-03-17T09:12:40Z

sam: policy changes are in. I restarted the fleet manager to roll new runners.

maya: starting a manual rerun of the failing workflow now. @ci-bot please report back.

ci-bot: rerun triggered: workflow run #3421 (rerun-1).

ci-bot: rerun #3421 finished: success ✅ — all jobs green.

maya: thanks team. follow-ups: 1) add a pre-merge CI check that ensures PRs touching broker roles include a justification and signal to not remove runner kms perms; 2) add an alert when KMS Decrypt returns PERMISSION_DENIED from runner principal (we had none). I'll file those.

ow: noted. I'll add the rule to the iam-reviewer checklist.

jen: filing alert ticket and linking to the PR. ticket: INFRA-987.

maya: awesome. closing thread once infra ticket has the alert and iam checklist updated. :+1:
